rationale: Full-viewport background photo with dark overlay, left-aligned eyebrow, display H1, lead text and two buttons.
visualCharacteristics.purpose: full-viewport page-opening hero with a background photo, dark overlay and left-aligned headline and CTAs

contentPattern.description: Full-bleed background photo with overlaid headline and CTAs: a hero.
contentPattern.structure: row 1: background image (optional); row 2: eyebrow paragraph, H1 heading, lead paragraph, CTA links (one link per paragraph; bold = primary, italic = secondary)

cells: Eyebrow paragraph, heading, subheading, CTA links

usage: Use once at the top of a page for a photo-backed opening statement.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any full-bleed photo hero with overlaid text. For an image-less centered banner use hero-cta.

sectionMetadata.note: Photo background belongs to the hero block; section is not colored.
